paraphrase: In this telling Gorakṣa is born in the Kṛta age of Brahmā's seed and named by the sage Viśravas; as a student his ear is cut in punishment, and he declares: 'I will not follow the brāhmaṇa-dharma; I take up the Gorakṣa-dharma' — taking the guru's garb, the split ear and the cut top-knot; with Jālandhara, Matsyendra and Dattātreya he makes known the supreme Gorakṣa-dharma.
notes: Ref checked against the local e-text (Muktabodha M00291); the Sanskrit is corrupt and the paraphrase tentative. This origin story differs from the common vernacular account (birth from Matsyendra's ash).
speaker: Mahādeva
